contexts: Medical school, 180 second-year students per year
Eight faculty-led sessions plus optional near-peer sessions since 2024
Four years of station scores; two years of attendance registers
No funding; 4 hours per week of staff time
reading: The decision turns on two quantities: the effect of replacing half the faculty sessions on first-attempt pass rates, and the change in cost. The retrieved effect evidence suggests similar performance, but local comparisons based on optional attendance are dominated by self-selection, so the existing data cannot give a fair effect estimate. Costs depend heavily on whether tutor time is valued and on calibration training. A fair comparison needs allocation by timetable block, with the historical years as context only.
